reason: A DeepSeek Harness Workspace tab for reviewing agent-touched files and session artifacts, inspecting Git state and history, and managing session-scoped Workspace Memory.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Workspace 标签页，用于查看智能体触碰的文件和会话产物、检查 Git 变更与历史，并管理会话范围的工作区记忆。
summaries.en: Adds a DeepSeek Harness Workspace tab for reviewing agent-touched files and session artifacts, inspecting Git changes and history, and managing session-scoped Workspace Memory.

capabilities: Reads session-scoped agent activity, artifacts, and workspace files
Previews bounded content including Markdown, images, Mermaid diagrams, and PDFs
Displays Git repository status, changes, diffs, history, and commit details
Creates and manages local Workspace Memory records and reviews agent proposals
Supports downloading artifacts and copying file paths or diffs
